outcome: Umbilical artery (UA) systolic to diastolic (S/D) ratio
cohort: 64 pregnant women in their third trimester with oligohydramnios referred for obstetrical sonography
finding: Oligohydramnios in the third trimester of pregnancy is associated with altered hemodynamic parameters in both the umbilical artery and middle cerebral artery, suggesting potential vascular remodeling in response to reduced amniotic fluid.
